rules.title: Paušal turnover limit
rules.statement_sr: Pravo na paušalno oporezivanje ne može se priznati obvezniku čiji je ukupan promet u godini koja prethodi godini za koju se utvrđuje porez, odnosno čiji je planirani promet kada počinje obavljanje delatnosti - veći od 6.000.000 dinara.
rules.statement_en: Flat-rate taxation is not granted to a taxpayer whose total turnover in the year before the tax year (or planned turnover when starting) is above 6,000,000 dinars. When the limit is crossed during a year, the tax office orders business books from mid-year or from the next year (Art. 42). Headroom sums the calendar-year turnover of issued invoices against this limit.

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dohodak građana ("Sl. glasnik RS" 24/2001 ... 80/2026), consolidated text on paragraf.rs
Biznis.rs, 7 Nov 2025: Limit od šest miliona dinara koči razvoj preduzetnika
sources.quote: Ključni limit za ostanak u paušalnom sistemu – godišnji promet od šest miliona dinara – nije se menjao još od 2013. godine

rules.title: What counts toward the 6M limit
rules.statement_sr: Promet se računa po datumu izdavanja fakture u kalendarskoj godini; avansi bez fakture se ne računaju kao promet.
rules.statement_en: Turnover is counted by invoice issue date within the calendar year, summed across all activities. A payment received without an invoice is shown as a discrepancy, not as turnover.

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dohodak građana ("Sl. glasnik RS" 24/2001 ... 80/2026), consolidated text on paragraf.rs

rules.note: Not settled for advances received before an invoice. Minimax counts revenue by supply date (datum prometa).

rules.title: What crossing 6M means
rules.statement_sr: Ukoliko preduzetnik pređe limit od šest miliona dinara prelazi u režim vođenja poslovnih knjiga, od 1. jula ako je limit pređen u prvoj polovini godine, ili od 1. januara naredne godine ako se prekoračenje dogodi kasnije.
rules.statement_en: Crossing 6M means keeping full business books: from 1 July if crossed in the first half of the year, otherwise from 1 January of the next year.

sources.title: Biznis.rs, 7 Nov 2025: Limit od šest miliona dinara koči razvoj preduzetnika
sources.quote: To se dešava od 1. jula ako je limit pređen u prvoj polovini godine, ili od 1. januara naredne ako se prekoračenje dogodi kasnije.

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dohodak građana ("Sl. glasnik RS" 24/2001 ... 80/2026), consolidated text on paragraf.rs

rules.note: The Serbian statement is quoted from Biznis.rs reporting; the legal basis is ZPDG Art. 42(5).

rules.title: Independence-test income is outside the 6M turnover
rules.statement_sr: U ukupni promet obveznika u smislu stava 2. tačka 4) ovog člana ne uračunava se prihod koji se oporezuje saglasno članu 85. stav 1. tačka 17) ovog zakona.
rules.statement_en: Income taxed as other income after a failed independence test is not counted in the 6M turnover. Headroom does not apply this automatically; it notes it when a client shows "fails".

sources.title: Zakon o porezu na dohodak građana ("Sl. glasnik RS" 24/2001 ... 80/2026), consolidated text on paragraf.rs

rules.title: Card bands
rules.statement_sr: Zelena ispod 80%, žuta od 80% do 90%, crvena od 90% do 100%, prekoračeno od 100%.
rules.statement_en: Green below 80%, amber from 80% to below 90%, red from 90% to below 100%, crossed at 100% or more. The 90% line mirrors the Minimax warning.

sources.title: Minimax help: Upozorenje za ulazak paušalaca u knjigaše ili za ulazak u sistem PDV-a (updated 23 Jul 2026), quoting Ministry of Finance opinion 011-00-00369/2017-04 of 9 Jun 2017

rules.note: A Headroom display convention, not a legal rule.
